rules.T1: Official project / founder / foundation / exchange / government / regulator / explorer accounts, and primary filings or press releases.
rules.T2: Established research firms, data providers, on-chain analysts and major news outlets with a track record.
rules.T3: Community accounts. Only shown when the same claim is corroborated by a T1 or T2 source.
rules.exclude: Accounts younger than ~6 months, bought-follower patterns (high followers with near-zero engagement), engagement farming (giveaways, 'like & RT' bait, recycled 'BREAKING' threads), bots, spam, impersonators and anything on the blocklist.

blocklist_reasons.vestemd: account created 2026-10, 0 followers, unverified stolen-asset table
